independent_references_methodology.reference_a_known_ground_truth_suite: 5 canonical 1280x720 stereo scenes (slanted_planes, occlusion_boundaries, thin_structures, repetitive_and_subpixel, low_texture_surface) with exact analytical ground-truth disparity and non-occluded masks, executed on the native Vulkan GPU pipelines.
independent_references_methodology.reference_b_independent_zncc_epipolar: Estimator-independent 1D 9x9 epipolar ZNCC subpixel template correspondence reference (peak ZNCC >= 0.90, second-peak uniqueness ratio <= 0.78, bidirectional LR symmetry <= 0.65 px) evaluated across all 5 distinct physical ZED 2 frames (record_ordinal 0..4). Neither native SGM nor OpenCV SGBM participates in constructing this reference.
